scripts.build: set -e; for d in packages/* examples/* apps/web; do if [ -f "$d/package.json" ]; then (cd "$d" && bun run build); fi; done
scripts.test: set -e; for d in packages/*; do if [ -f "$d/package.json" ]; then (cd "$d" && bun run test); fi; done; bun run --cwd examples/basic-agent start
scripts.typecheck: set -e; for d in packages/* examples/* apps/web; do if [ -f "$d/package.json" ]; then (cd "$d" && bun run typecheck); fi; done
